title: Llama 3
before: Llama 2 had been trained on two trillion tokens.
problem: Chinchilla-optimal training leaves inference-time performance on the table for a model you serve constantly.
breakthrough: 8B and 70B models trained on fifteen trillion tokens, far past the compute-optimal point.
why: Overtraining for inference efficiency became the open-model norm, and these were the first widely deployed examples.
next: Llama 3.1 added the 405B model and 128K context.
inherits: Train small models for much longer than compute-optimal.
